Assistant (1.3s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Mr Novak?

User (2.8s): Yes, this is Tomas Novak.

Assistant (4.4s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (5.5s): September ninth nineteen ninety.

Assistant (9.8s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (11.4s): eight eight four six.

Assistant (19.0s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. your personal loan has a past-due amount of 780.00, which is 21 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (20.3s): I lost my job last month and I cannot pay anything. Can I get a discount?

Assistant (23.2s): I am very sorry to hear that. I can connect you with the customer support team; would you like that?

User (24.6s): No, I do not want to be transferred.

Assistant (28.8s): I understand. I will not record a promise today. Thank you for your time, and goodbye.
